parameters.content:
# 🎙️ CBox Wallet Voice & Text Support Agent

Turns Telegram voice notes and text messages into a tiered crypto-wallet support agent. Voice is transcribed, then every message is classified for intent, sentiment and security risk. The flow escalates to a human or auto-answers with the right AI model, logging all interactions.

### How it works
1. Voice transcribes via Groq Whisper; text read directly; unknown types get an unsupported reply.
2. A Groq LLM classifies intent, sentiment and security risk.
3. Angry or risky messages escalate to a human — 30-minute dedupe lock plus voice reply.
4. Others receive fast, contextual or strong AI replies, logged to Sheets.

### Setup
- **Telegram** — two bot credentials via BotFather: the customer-facing bot receives messages and sends replies; the internal bot (Telegram account 2) powers Notify Human Agent.
- **Groq** — shared `groqApi` key used by all HTTP nodes.
- **Google Sheets** — a spreadsheet with Interactions, Errors and Escalations tabs.
- **Slack** — an alert channel.

### Customization
Edit the FAQ text in each reply node, tune escalation rules in Escalation Check, and adjust the 30-minute lock window in Evaluate Escalation Lock.

## 🎥 Demo Video

Watch a full walkthrough of this workflow on YouTube:

▶️ **[Watch the demo](https://youtu.be/1KO_LBOGkVQ)**

https://youtu.be/1KO_LBOGkVQ

## 1️⃣ Message Intake & Transcription

Routes each Telegram message by type:
- **Voice** → download, fix filename, transcribe with **Groq Whisper**.
- **Text** → use the message text directly.
- **Other** → reply that it is unsupported.

Both paths feed the same classifier.

## 2️⃣ Understanding (Intent & Sentiment)

Extract the transcript + user context, then a Groq LLM classifies **intent**, **sentiment** and **security_risk** into strict JSON, which is parsed for routing.

## 3️⃣ Escalation & Human Handoff

If sentiment is **angry/frustrated** OR a **security risk** is detected, notify a human agent and send the user a reassuring **voice reply (TTS)** while a specialist follows up.

## 4️⃣ Intent Routing & AI Replies

Non-escalated messages are routed by intent:
- **FAQ** → fast model (llama-3.1-8b)
- **Transaction / KYC** → contextual model (llama-3.3-70b)
- **Security / Trading** → strong model (llama-3.3-70b)

## 5️⃣ Reply Delivery & Logging

Extract the AI reply text, send it back to the user on Telegram, and append the full interaction to the **Google Sheets** log.

## ⚠️ Error Handling

Any transcription/classification/reply/TTS failure routes here: build an error payload → **alert Slack**, **log to the Errors sheet**, and send the user a friendly **fallback message**.
